html:
G'oya

Bitta guruhdan uch xil son kerak. Jami COUNT(*) bilan, qolgan ikkitasi shartli: CASE har bir qatorga 1 yoki 0 beradi, SUM ularni qo'shadi. Natijada paid shu mijozning 'paid' qatorlari soniga teng bo'ladi.

Yechim

SELECT customer_id,
       COUNT(*) AS total,
       SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS paid,
       SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cancelled
FROM orders
GROUP BY customer_id

Namunada 1-mijozda 4 ta buyurtma: 2 tasi to'langan, 1 tasi bekor qilingan. 3-mijozda faqat bitta yangi buyurtma, uning paid va cancelled ustunlari 0.

Tuzoqlar

ELSE 0 tashlab ketilsa, mos kelmagan qatorda CASE NULL beradi. 3-mijozning birorta to'langan buyurtmasi yo'q, SUM faqat NULL lardan yig'iladi va 0 o'rniga NULL qaytaradi:

Noto'g'riSELECT customer_id,
       COUNT(*) AS total,
       SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN 1 END) AS paid,
       SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'cancelled' THEN 1 END) AS cancelled
FROM orders
GROUP BY customer_id

Teskari xato COUNT bilan ELSE 0 yozish. COUNT qiymatga qaramaydi, faqat NULL emasligini tekshiradi. 0 ham qiymat, shuning uchun COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) hamma buyurtmani sanab chiqadi.

Boshqa yo'l

COUNT bilan ham bo'ladi, faqat ELSE siz. Mos kelmagan qator NULL oladi va sanalmaydi, mos keladigani bo'lmasa COUNT o'zi 0 qaytaradi:

SELECT customer_id,
       COUNT(*) AS total,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN 1 END) AS paid,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'cancelled' THEN 1 END) AS cancelled
FROM orders
GROUP BY customer_id

Ikkala bazada FILTER ham ishlaydi: COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'paid').
